title: Pre-K Tuition Late Fee: Billing Month, Due Day and Amount
content:
**Clause.** For a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the late fee is worked out as follows.

1. **Billing month.** The late fee is assessed for the enrollment's most recent billing month: the latest billing month that carries a tuition charge.
2. **Due day.** That month's due day is the day of the billing month given by the type's tuition due day in the board-approved fee schedule. When that month's tuition charge posted after that day of the month, the due day is instead the day that falls that same number of days after the charge posted.
3. **Open balance and unpaid part.** The open balance is the enrollment's tuition charges, late fees and refunds less its payments and credits, payments reaching the oldest open charge first. The part of the month's tuition still unpaid is the lesser of that month's tuition charge and the open balance, and never less than zero.
4. **Months that owe nothing.** A billing month owes no late fee at all, and nothing is booked for it, when any of these holds: it already carries a late fee; none of its tuition is still unpaid on the day the fee is assessed; or its due day is fewer than the type's late-fee offset (in days) before that day.
5. **Amount.** The late fee is the type's tuition late fee, as listed in the board-approved fee schedule.
6. **Combination and rounding.** Every amount the board's late-fee schedule sets for a fee is combined with the type's tuition late fee in one order: first amounts that take the place of the fee and amounts added to it, then any limit, then amounts taken off, never taking the fee below zero. Only that final amount is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

## Finding the due day (hypothetical dates, due day 5)

| Tuition charge for the month posted on | Posted after day 5? | Due day |
|---|---|---|
| the 1st of the billing month | no | the 5th of the billing month |
| the 5th of the billing month | no | the 5th of the billing month |
| the 20th of the billing month | yes | the 25th (5 days after the charge posted) |

## Whether a fee is owed on a given day (hypothetical, offset of 1 day)

| The most recent billing month | Due day | Day of assessment | Owed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| carries no late fee, part of its tuition unpaid | the 5th | the 6th | yes: the due day is 1 day before |
| carries no late fee, part of its tuition unpaid | the 5th | the 5th | no: the due day is 0 days before |
| carries no late fee, all of its tuition paid | the 5th | the 9th | no: nothing is still unpaid |
| already carries a late fee | the 5th | the 9th | no: the month already carries one |

## Worked amount

A month that owes a fee is charged the type's tuition late fee, rounded to the cent. A month that owes nothing is charged nothing.
